race.comment: MADE IN ITALY (3) frustrating mare who doesn't have to improve much to win this over the mile. Savaged the line in a decent contest when second over 1400m at Newcastle. McEvoy sticks with the good weight drop. Genuine contender. PALM TREE (11) relished the extra trip when she closed off well at her second race start to finish second over 1450m at Illawarra Grange. Nice weight drop with Grima's claim and no excuses here. TRUE TONE (7) warmed up when the race was all over as the ($1.30 fav), with a narrow second over 1500m Hawkesbury. Extra trip in his favour from the rails draw. KOIBITO (1) was a year between runs on resumption with a tough on-pace second over 1250m at Newcastle. Meeting a deeper field this time and should strip fitter. Each way.
